inicio.kicker: Course · step 3 of From chat to agent · 7 lessons
inicio.titulo: Queues: send ten tasks, go to sleep, and check the results in the morning
inicio.lead: An agent in chat does one thing at a time, and only while you watch. In this course, you’ll set up your queue: decide what goes in, understand a simple queue, install inemaccbot, add gates before the important steps, and learn to review the batch the next day.
inicio.capa_alt: Office at night with a laptop showing a list of completed tasks and a phone beside it.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order you’ll do them: first understand and decide, then install, send, add gates, and review. Prerequisite: steps 1 (terminal) and 2 (your Jarvis) of the training.

itens: People who already use an agent in the terminal (step 1) and have an assistant with rules (step 2).
People who repeat the same tasks every week: transcribe, summarize, draft, generate video.
People who want to leave the computer working overnight without worrying about losing what it did.

blocos.t: What you’ll be able to do
itens: Sort your tasks into: goes in the queue, needs a gate, stays with you.
Run a simple queue and see how it resumes after an interruption.
Install inemaccbot until /ping responds in your Telegram.
Send a batch one night, approve it at the gate, and measure in the morning how many came out right on the first try.
Turn the task that failed most into a new rule.
